The latest 4h BTC return is negative after a substantial 12h-72h advance, displayed BTC depth imbalance is strongly negative, funding increased, and sentiment softened from an extreme level. Counterevidence is broad breadth, positive 12h-72h momentum, and declining BTC open interest. A move of at least 3% lower from the latest BTC mark is a bounded research event, not a canonical forecast.

Unratified ETH pullback candidate with lower confidence than the short-horizon BTC candidate. ETH has negative latest 4h return and negative latest ETH/BTC return, while short-dated ETH moneyness-bucket skew is materially negative. However, ETH remains much stronger over 12h-72h, ETH/BTC persistence is positive, and breadth is stable. Candidate requires a 4% decline from the latest ETH mark within five days.

This candidate describes continued near-term consolidation inside the observed recent BTC range rather than a directional breakout.
